snippet_primary: "You can upload multiple files, including ebooks, PDFs, audio, video, or other file types. Each file can be up to 5GB in size." … "We support most file types, including PDFs, audio, video, ZIP files, and more. However, certain file types such as EXE, ISO, DMG, VBS, SCR, and JAR are not supported."
subject_exact: Payhip digital product uploads accept multiple files up to 5GB each across most file types, excluding EXE, ISO, DMG, VBS, SCR, and JAR
